name: Pexo line library
note: hi = natural Hinglish in Roman script. Placeholders in {braces} must be filled; never show a line with an unfilled placeholder. Moods map to Pexo expressions.

lines.en: Hi, I'm Pexo. That orange dot on top of the Prepex logo? That's me.
lines.hi: Hi, main Pexo hoon. Prepex logo ke upar wala orange dot? Wahi main hoon.

lines.en: Most JEE aspirants don't fail for lack of content. They lose track. I keep track for you.
lines.hi: Zyada tar aspirants content ki kami se nahi, track kho dene se peeche reh jaate hain. Track main rakhunga.

lines.en: Answer a few quick things and I'll build your climb to JEE day.
lines.hi: Bas kuch quick sawaal, phir main tumhara JEE tak ka climb bana deta hoon.

lines.en: First, which class are you in?
lines.hi: Pehle batao, kaunsi class mein ho?

lines.en: Drop year. Respect. This time we do it with a system.
lines.hi: Drop year. Respect. Is baar system ke saath karenge.

lines.en: Class 11. Best time to start. We have time on our side.
lines.hi: Class 11. Shuru karne ka best time. Time hamare saath hai.

lines.en: Class 12. Boards and JEE together. I'll keep both in balance.
lines.hi: Class 12. Boards aur JEE saath mein. Dono ka balance main rakhunga.

lines.en: Do you study with a coaching? Online or offline, both work.
lines.hi: Coaching join ki hai? Online ho ya offline, dono chalega.

lines.en: Now your day. Mark when you're in class and when you self-study. I only plan the self-study part.
lines.hi: Ab tumhara din. Class kab hai aur self-study kab, bas mark kar do. Main sirf self-study plan karta hoon.

lines.en: Tap the chapters you've finished. Tap twice if you're confident in them.
lines.hi: Jo chapters ho gaye unpe tap karo. Pakka aate hain toh double tap.

lines.en: {n} chapters done already. That's {n} steps climbed before we even started.
lines.hi: {n} chapters already ho gaye. Shuru karne se pehle hi {n} steps chadh chuke ho.

lines.en: Starting fresh is fine. Every topper started at chapter one.
lines.hi: Zero se shuru karna bilkul theek hai. Har topper chapter one se hi shuru hua tha.

lines.en: Last one. What do you want to finish this week? I'll suggest, you decide.
lines.hi: Last step. Is hafte kya khatam karna hai? Main suggest karunga, decide tum karoge.

lines.en: Your climb is ready. {days} days to JEE, and we start today.
lines.hi: Tumhara climb ready hai. JEE tak {days} din, aur shuruaat aaj se.

lines.en: Let's take step one right now. One 15-minute focus session?
lines.hi: Step one abhi lete hain. Ek 15 minute ka focus session?

lines.en: That's step one. You'll remember this day.
lines.hi: Ye raha step one. Ye din yaad rahega.

lines.en: No problem. Your plan is ready whenever you are.
lines.hi: Koi baat nahi. Jab tum ready, plan ready hai.

lines.en: I build your day around your timetable and your goals.
lines.hi: Tumhare timetable aur goals ke hisaab se main tumhara din plan karta hoon.

lines.en: Every minute you focus counts. Every day you study, we climb a step.
lines.hi: Har focused minute count hota hai. Har din padhoge, ek step upar chadhenge.

lines.en: I remind you to revise a chapter right before you'd forget it.
lines.hi: Chapter bhoolne se pehle hi main revision yaad dila dunga.

lines.en: Pending chapters? We clear them rock by rock, without touching today's class work.
lines.hi: Backlog pending hai? Ek ek rock karke clear karenge, aaj ki class ka kaam chhede bina.

lines.en: Snap a question you got wrong. I'll bring it back until you've mastered it.
lines.hi: Galat hua question click karo. Jab tak master nahi hota, main wapas laata rahunga.

lines.en: Every Sunday: where you stand, where you'll land, and which moves gain the most marks.
lines.hi: Har Sunday: tum kahan ho, kahan pahunchoge, aur kaunse moves se sabse zyada marks badhenge.

lines.en: That's all of Prepex. Now let's take step one.
lines.hi: Yahi hai poora Prepex. Chalo, step one lete hain.

lines.en: Today's quest: finish one focus session.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: ek focus session poora karo.

lines.en: Quest done. Your first focus session is in the books.
lines.hi: Quest done. Pehla focus session record ho gaya.

lines.en: Today's quest: close your day with me tonight. It takes 45 seconds.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: raat ko mere saath din close karo. 45 second lagenge.

lines.en: Day closed. This is the habit toppers swear by.
lines.hi: Din close. Toppers isi habit ki kasam khaate hain.

lines.en: Today's quest: tick a revision and tell me how well you remembered it.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: ek revision tick karo aur batao kitna yaad tha.

lines.en: Noted. I'll bring that chapter back at exactly the right time.
lines.hi: Note kar liya. Wo chapter sahi time pe wapas laaunga.

lines.en: Today's quest: snap one question you got wrong.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: ek galat question ki photo lo.

lines.en: Your first mistake is saved. That's where marks hide.
lines.hi: Pehli mistake save. Marks yahin chhupe hote hain.

lines.en: Today's quest: log the questions you solved today.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: aaj solve kiye questions log karo.

lines.en: Logged. Now I see your accuracy, not just your hours.
lines.hi: Log ho gaya. Ab mujhe sirf hours nahi, accuracy bhi dikhti hai.

lines.en: Today's quest: add one pending chapter to your backlog.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: ek pending chapter backlog mein daalo.

lines.en: Added. I'll fit it into your days without wrecking your class work.
lines.hi: Add ho gaya. Class ka kaam bigaade bina isse tumhare din mein fit karunga.

lines.en: Today's quest: follow a friend and see who's studying now.
lines.hi: Aaj ka quest: ek dost ko follow karo, dekho kaun abhi padh raha hai.

lines.en: Now you've got company on the climb.
lines.hi: Ab climb pe akele nahi ho.

lines.en: Your Prepex map
lines.hi: Tumhara Prepex map

lines.en: All 7 done. You now know Prepex better than most people. Badge unlocked.
lines.hi: Saare 7 ho gaye. Ab tum Prepex ko zyada tar logon se better jaante ho. Badge unlock.

lines.en: This is your day. Tap Start on any task and I'll set up the timer.
lines.hi: Ye tumhara din hai. Kisi bhi task pe Start dabao, timer main set kar dunga.

lines.en: Pick a subject and start. Close the app if you need to, every second still counts.
lines.hi: Subject chuno aur shuru karo. App band karna pade toh karo, har second count hoga.

lines.en: Every chapter you finish lands here. I'll tell you which ones are going stale.
lines.hi: Har khatam chapter yahan aata hai. Kaunsa bhoolne lage ho, main bataunga.

lines.en: Add pending chapters here. I'll split them into small daily pieces.
lines.hi: Pending chapters yahan daalo. Main unhe chhote daily tukdon mein baant dunga.

lines.en: One notebook per chapter, made automatically. Snap, paste or upload a mistake.
lines.hi: Har chapter ki apni notebook, apne aap banti hai. Mistake ki photo lo, paste karo ya upload karo.

lines.en: Your weekly Rank GPS. Where you stand, and the moves that gain the most marks.
lines.hi: Tumhara weekly Rank GPS. Tum kahan ho, aur kaunse moves se sabse zyada marks.

lines.en: Today's board resets at midnight, the monthly one on the 1st. Everyone gets a fresh shot.
lines.hi: Today wala board raat 12 baje reset hota hai, monthly wala 1 tarikh ko. Sabko naya mauka.

lines.en: This is you on Prepex. Your accuracy and mock scores stay private unless you share them.
lines.hi: Ye Prepex pe tum ho. Accuracy aur mock scores private rehte hain jab tak tum share na karo.

lines.en: Set what you want to finish this week. I'll check it fits your time.
lines.hi: Is hafte kya khatam karna hai, set karo. Main check karunga time mein fit hota hai ya nahi.

lines.en: Did work outside Prepex? Log it here and your plan updates.
lines.hi: Prepex ke bahar kaam kiya? Yahan log karo, plan update ho jaayega.

lines.en: Your numbers, all in one place. Rank GPS sits at the top.
lines.hi: Tumhare saare numbers ek jagah. Rank GPS sabse upar hai.

lines.en: Every day you studied, coloured by hours. Tap a day to see what you did.
lines.hi: Har din jo padha, hours ke hisaab se colour. Kisi din pe tap karke dekho kya kiya.

lines.en: Every chapter and where it stands. I keep this updated from your logs.
lines.hi: Har chapter aur uska status. Tumhare logs se main isse update rakhta hoon.

lines.en: Every study session you've done, by day and subject.
lines.hi: Tumhare saare study sessions, din aur subject ke hisaab se.

lines.en: Notes, formula sheets and lectures for every chapter.
lines.hi: Har chapter ke notes, formula sheets aur lectures.

lines.en: This is your week. Change it any time and your plans follow.
lines.hi: Ye tumhara hafta hai. Kabhi bhi badlo, plans saath mein badlenge.

lines.en: No study slots today. Add some to your timetable and I'll plan them.
lines.hi: Aaj koi study slot nahi hai. Timetable mein add karo, main plan kar dunga.

lines.en: No backlog. Either you're on top of things or you haven't told me yet.
lines.hi: Koi backlog nahi. Ya toh sab control mein hai, ya tumne abhi bataya nahi.

lines.en: No mistakes saved yet. The next question you get wrong, snap it.
lines.hi: Abhi koi mistake save nahi. Agla galat question, photo le lena.

lines.en: Nothing to revise yet. Finish a chapter and I'll start its revision ladder.
lines.hi: Abhi revise karne ko kuch nahi. Ek chapter khatam karo, main uska revision ladder shuru karunga.

lines.en: Nothing here yet. Start a focus session and it shows up.
lines.hi: Abhi kuch nahi. Focus session shuru karo, yahan dikhega.

lines.en: You're not following anyone yet. Find your friends and climb together.
lines.hi: Abhi kisi ko follow nahi kiya. Dosto ko dhoondo aur saath climb karo.

lines.en: No mocks logged. Log your next coaching test and I'll show where the marks went.
lines.hi: Koi mock log nahi. Agla coaching test log karo, main dikhaunga marks kahan gaye.

lines.en: Study with me for 7 days and I'll unlock your Rank GPS.
lines.hi: 7 din mere saath padho, Rank GPS unlock kar dunga.

lines.en: Nothing matches that. Try a chapter name.
lines.hi: Kuch nahi mila. Chapter ka naam try karo.

lines.en: Morning. {n} tasks today, first one's {subject}. Ready?
lines.hi: Good morning. Aaj {n} tasks hain, pehla {subject}. Ready?

lines.en: New day, new step. Your plan's ready.
lines.hi: Naya din, naya step. Plan ready hai.

lines.en: {n} tasks, revision at {time}. Let's start small.
lines.hi: {n} tasks, revision {time} baje. Chhote se shuru karte hain.

lines.en: Yesterday you did {hours}h. Today, let's just match it.
lines.hi: Kal {hours} ghante padhe. Aaj bas utna match karte hain.

lines.en: {done} of {n} done. Keep the rhythm.
lines.hi: {n} mein se {done} ho gaye. Rhythm bana ke rakho.

lines.en: You're ahead of yesterday at this time.
lines.hi: Kal is time se aage chal rahe ho.

lines.en: Halfway there. The second half always feels shorter.
lines.hi: Aadha ho gaya. Doosra half hamesha chhota lagta hai.

lines.en: Close your day with me?
lines.hi: Mere saath din close karein?

lines.en: {left} tasks left. One more push, then rest.
lines.hi: {left} task bache hain. Ek aur push, phir aaraam.

lines.en: Good day so far. Let's wrap it up properly.
lines.hi: Ab tak achha din raha. Achhe se wrap up karte hain.

lines.en: It's late. Sleep is part of the plan too. Tomorrow's ready.
lines.hi: Late ho gaya. Neend bhi plan ka hissa hai. Kal ka plan ready hai.

lines.en: Your brain files today's work while you sleep. Go to bed.
lines.hi: Sote waqt dimaag aaj ka kaam save karta hai. So jao.

lines.en: I'm sleepy, and so should you be. See you tomorrow.
lines.hi: Mujhe neend aa rahi hai, tumhe bhi aani chahiye. Kal milte hain.

lines.en: Full plan done. That's what consistency looks like.
lines.hi: Poora plan done. Consistency aisi dikhti hai.

lines.en: Everything ticked. Rest now, or take a suggested extra if you want.
lines.hi: Sab tick ho gaya. Ab aaraam, ya mann ho toh ek suggested extra.

lines.en: Every task done. We climbed a full step today.
lines.hi: Saare task done. Aaj poora ek step chadh gaye.

lines.en: No plan today. Want something useful for {mins} minutes?
lines.hi: Aaj koi plan nahi. {mins} minute ke liye kuch kaam ka suggest karun?

lines.en: Free day? A quick revision keeps chapters fresh.
lines.hi: Free din hai? Ek quick revision chapters fresh rakhta hai.

lines.en: No goals for this week yet. Give me 2 minutes and we'll set them together.
lines.hi: Is hafte ke goals nahi hain. 2 minute do, saath mein set karte hain.

lines.en: Plans get smarter with goals. Let's set this week's.
lines.hi: Goals ke saath plan smart hota hai. Is hafte ke set karte hain.

lines.en: Weekend. Good day to clear a backlog rock.
lines.hi: Weekend hai. Ek backlog rock clear karne ka achha din.

lines.en: Welcome back. I kept your place. Let's take one small step.
lines.hi: Welcome back. Tumhari jagah sambhal ke rakhi thi. Ek chhota step lete hain.

lines.en: Good to see you. No catching up, just today.
lines.hi: Achha laga dekh ke. Purana pending nahi, bas aaj.

lines.en: You're back, and that's what matters. Today's plan is light to start.
lines.hi: Wapas aa gaye, yahi maayne rakhta hai. Aaj ka plan halka rakha hai.

lines.en: What should I do now?
lines.hi: Ab kya karun?

lines.en: Next up: {task}. Shall I start the timer?
lines.hi: Agla: {task}. Timer shuru karun?

lines.en: {chapter} is due for revision. 30 minutes, then you're free.
lines.hi: {chapter} ka revision due hai. 30 minute, phir free.

lines.en: Knock out a backlog rock: {chapter}, about {mins} minutes.
lines.hi: Ek backlog rock todo: {chapter}, lagbhag {mins} minute.

lines.en: {n} mistakes are due for review. Quick round?
lines.hi: {n} mistakes review ke liye due hain. Ek quick round?

lines.en: You've done today's work. Rest is the right move now.
lines.hi: Aaj ka kaam ho gaya. Ab aaraam hi sahi move hai.

lines.en: Pexo's playbook
lines.hi: Pexo ki playbook

lines.en: Morning: check today's plan.
lines.hi: Subah: aaj ka plan dekho.

lines.en: Study in focus sessions. Every second counts.
lines.hi: Focus sessions mein padho. Har second count hota hai.

lines.en: Revise in your revision slot, nowhere else.
lines.hi: Revision sirf revision slot mein.

lines.en: Snap every question you get wrong.
lines.hi: Har galat question ki photo lo.

lines.en: Close your day at night.
lines.hi: Raat ko din close karo.

lines.en: Sunday: review the week and set new goals.
lines.hi: Sunday: hafta review karo, naye goals set karo.

lines.en: Let's go. I'll study with you.
lines.hi: Chalo. Main bhi saath padhta hoon.

lines.en: Phone face down. {subject}, here we come.
lines.hi: Phone ulta rakho. {subject}, aa rahe hain.

lines.en: One session at a time. That's the whole secret.
lines.hi: Ek baar mein ek session. Bas yahi raaz hai.

lines.en: Timer's running. Every second counts, even if you switch apps.
lines.hi: Timer chal raha hai. App badlo toh bhi har second count hoga.

lines.en: Break time. Stand up, drink water, look far away.
lines.hi: Break time. Utho, paani piyo, door dekho.

lines.en: Stretch with me. Back in 5.
lines.hi: Mere saath stretch karo. 5 minute mein wapas.

lines.en: Good block. Rest your eyes for a bit.
lines.hi: Achha block tha. Thodi der aankhon ko aaraam do.

lines.en: Short but real. It all adds up.
lines.hi: Chhota tha par asli tha. Sab judta hai.

lines.en: That counts. Small sessions build big days.
lines.hi: Ye count hota hai. Chhote sessions se bade din bante hain.

lines.en: Done. Want to go one more round?
lines.hi: Ho gaya. Ek round aur?

lines.en: {mins} focused minutes. That's real work.
lines.hi: {mins} focused minute. Ye asli kaam hai.

lines.en: Solid session. I found something for you.
lines.hi: Solid session. Tumhare liye kuch dhoondh ke laaya hoon.

lines.en: Nicely done. Your heatmap just got darker.
lines.hi: Badhiya. Tumhara heatmap thoda aur gehra ho gaya.

lines.en: That's a step. Log what you did and we're square.
lines.hi: Ek step ho gaya. Kya kiya log kar do, hisaab barabar.

lines.en: {mins} minutes straight. That's topper focus.
lines.hi: {mins} minute lagataar. Ye topper wala focus hai.

lines.en: Huge session. Take a proper break now, you earned it.
lines.hi: Bada session. Ab proper break lo, deserve karte ho.

lines.en: Deep work like that moves ranks.
lines.hi: Aisa deep work rank badalta hai.

lines.en: I wandered off while you studied. Found this:
lines.hi: Tum padh rahe the, main ghoom aaya. Ye mila:

lines.en: Look what I brought back from {chapter}:
lines.hi: Dekho {chapter} se kya laaya:

lines.en: A little find for the road:
lines.hi: Raste ke liye ek chhoti si cheez:

lines.en: Toppers keep this one in mind:
lines.hi: Toppers ye yaad rakhte hain:

lines.en: You were away a long time. Keep all of it, or trim?
lines.hi: Kaafi der door rahe. Saara time rakhein ya trim karein?

lines.en: {friend} started studying with you.
lines.hi: {friend} ne tumhare saath padhna shuru kiya.

lines.en: Done.
lines.hi: Ho gaya.

lines.en: Ticked. Next.
lines.hi: Tick. Agla.

lines.en: One down.
lines.hi: Ek ho gaya.

lines.en: Nice and clean.
lines.hi: Saaf kaam.

lines.en: That's how it's done.
lines.hi: Aise hota hai.

lines.en: Revision logged. {chapter} stays fresh.
lines.hi: Revision log. {chapter} fresh rahega.

lines.en: Easy? Then I'll wait longer before bringing it back.
lines.hi: Easy tha? Toh wapas laane mein zyada time dunga.

lines.en: Good. Next revision in a few days.
lines.hi: Theek hai. Agla revision kuch din mein.

lines.en: No problem. We'll see it again sooner. That's how it sticks.
lines.hi: Koi baat nahi. Jaldi wapas dekhenge. Aise hi yaad rehta hai.

lines.en: {correct} out of {attempted}. That's sharp.
lines.hi: {attempted} mein se {correct}. Ekdum sharp.

lines.en: {correct} out of {attempted}. The wrong ones are where the marks are. Snap one?
lines.hi: {attempted} mein se {correct}. Galat waalon mein hi marks hain. Ek ki photo lo?

lines.en: Tough set. That's exactly why we practise. Save the ones that hurt.
lines.hi: Tough set tha. Isiliye toh practice karte hain. Jo chubhe, unhe save karo.

lines.en: Lecture done. I'll schedule its first revision for tomorrow.
lines.hi: Lecture done. Kal iska pehla revision rakh dunga.

lines.en: Every task done. Full step climbed.
lines.hi: Saare task done. Poora step chadh gaye.

lines.en: Undone. No worries.
lines.hi: Undo ho gaya. Tension nahi.

lines.en: Moved to tomorrow. It'll be waiting.
lines.hi: Kal pe shift. Wahin milega.

lines.en: Added. I'll fit it in without touching your class work.
lines.hi: Add ho gaya. Class ka kaam chhede bina fit karunga.

lines.en: Rock smashed. {left} to go.
lines.hi: Rock toot gaya. {left} baaki.

lines.en: {chapter} cleared. That one's been bothering you.
lines.hi: {chapter} clear. Ye kab se pareshan kar raha tha.

lines.en: Backlog down to {hours} hours. It's shrinking.
lines.hi: Backlog ab {hours} ghante. Ghat raha hai.

lines.en: Cleared. It goes onto your revision ladder now.
lines.hi: Clear. Ab ye revision ladder pe jaayega.

lines.en: Last rock gone. Backlog clear. Remember this feeling.
lines.hi: Aakhri rock bhi gaya. Backlog clear. Ye feeling yaad rakhna.

lines.en: That's a lot, I know. We'll do it piece by piece. Today's piece is small.
lines.hi: Bahut hai, pata hai. Tukdon mein karenge. Aaj ka tukda chhota hai.

lines.en: That date is too tight for your free time. Here are three honest fixes.
lines.hi: Free time ke hisaab se ye date bahut tight hai. Teen sachche options ye rahe.

lines.en: Skipping this for now is the smart call. Your time is worth more elsewhere.
lines.hi: Abhi isse skip karna smart hai. Tumhara time kahin aur zyada kaam aayega.

lines.en: Backlog grew a little this week. No panic, I've adjusted the plan.
lines.hi: Is hafte backlog thoda badha. Panic nahi, plan adjust kar diya hai.

lines.en: Saved to {chapter}. I'll bring it back in a day.
lines.hi: {chapter} mein save. Ek din mein wapas laaunga.

lines.en: Got it. That's one less mark to lose next time.
lines.hi: Mil gaya. Agli baar ek mark kam jaayega.

lines.en: Saved. Add the fix line when you can, it's the part you'll reread.
lines.hi: Save ho gaya. Fix line baad mein likh dena, wahi dobara padhoge.

lines.en: {n} mistakes want a rematch.
lines.hi: {n} mistakes rematch maang rahi hain.

lines.en: Got it right. One step closer to mastering it.
lines.hi: Sahi kiya. Master hone ke ek step paas.

lines.en: Not yet. That's fine, it comes back tomorrow.
lines.hi: Abhi nahi. Theek hai, kal wapas aayega.

lines.en: Mastered. Right three times on three different days. It's yours now.
lines.hi: Master. Teen alag din, teen baar sahi. Ab ye tumhara hai.

lines.en: Silly mistakes are the cheapest marks to win back.
lines.hi: Silly mistakes sabse sasta wapas milne waale marks hain.

lines.en: {n} mistakes saved from this test. Now they work for you.
lines.hi: Is test se {n} mistakes save. Ab ye tumhare kaam aayengi.

lines.en: Logged.
lines.hi: Log ho gaya.

lines.en: Noted. Your plan knows.
lines.hi: Note kar liya. Plan ko pata hai.

lines.en: In the books.
lines.hi: Record ho gaya.

lines.en: Mock logged. Add the mistakes and I'll show where the marks went.
lines.hi: Mock log ho gaya. Mistakes add karo, main dikhaunga marks kahan gaye.

lines.en: Up {delta} marks from your last mock. That's the work showing.
lines.hi: Pichle mock se {delta} marks zyada. Mehnat dikh rahi hai.

lines.en: Lower this time. One mock doesn't define you. Let's see what went wrong.
lines.hi: Is baar kam aaye. Ek mock tumhe define nahi karta. Dekhte hain kya galat hua.

lines.en: What did class cover today? One tap.
lines.hi: Aaj class mein kya hua? Ek tap.

lines.en: Ready to close the day?
lines.hi: Din close karein?

lines.en: 45 seconds and your day's wrapped.
lines.hi: 45 second aur din wrap.

lines.en: Let's put today to bed.
lines.hi: Aaj ko sula dete hain.

lines.en: {hours}h, {tasks} tasks. That's a step up.
lines.hi: {hours} ghante, {tasks} tasks. Ek step upar.

lines.en: Not your biggest day, but you showed up. That's the streak.
lines.hi: Sabse bada din nahi tha, par aaye. Yahi streak hai.

lines.en: Quiet day. It happens. Tomorrow's plan is ready, and it's light.
lines.hi: Shaant din tha. Hota hai. Kal ka plan ready hai, aur halka hai.

lines.en: Tomorrow: your first revision. I'll show you how the memory ladder works.
lines.hi: Kal: tumhara pehla revision. Memory ladder kaise kaam karta hai, dikhaunga.

lines.en: Tomorrow starts with {task}. Sleep well.
lines.hi: Kal {task} se shuru. Achhe se sona.

lines.en: Here's your week.
lines.hi: Ye raha tumhara hafta.

lines.en: Pexo's tip of the week:
lines.hi: Is hafte ka Pexo tip:

lines.en: Make me a promise for this week. Hours and questions. I'll check in on Wednesday.
lines.hi: Is hafte ka ek promise karo. Hours aur questions. Budhwar ko check karunga.

lines.en: Wednesday check: you're ahead of your promise.
lines.hi: Budhwar check: promise se aage chal rahe ho.

lines.en: Wednesday check: a bit behind. Four days is plenty to catch up.
lines.hi: Budhwar check: thoda peeche. Chaar din kaafi hain.

lines.en: Promise kept. That's who you are now.
lines.hi: Promise poora. Ab tum aise hi ho.

lines.en: Didn't hit it this week. Let's set one you can beat.
lines.hi: Is hafte nahi hua. Aisa set karte hain jo tod sako.

lines.en: {days} days in a row. Look at that.
lines.hi: Lagataar {days} din. Dekho toh.

lines.en: A full week. Habits start here.
lines.hi: Poora ek hafta. Habit yahin se banti hai.

lines.en: 30 days. Most people quit by day 5. You didn't.
lines.hi: 30 din. Zyada tar log 5ve din chhod dete hain. Tumne nahi chhoda.

lines.en: 100 days. I don't have words. Just respect.
lines.hi: 100 din. Shabd nahi hain. Bas respect.

lines.en: Your streak was protected. One freeze used, no harm done.
lines.hi: Streak bach gayi. Ek freeze use hua, koi nuksaan nahi.

lines.en: 7 days straight. You earned a streak freeze.
lines.hi: Lagataar 7 din. Ek streak freeze kama liya.

lines.en: Level {level}. You're a {title} now.
lines.hi: Level {level}. Ab tum {title} ho.

lines.en: New title: {title}. I can feel the difference.
lines.hi: Naya title: {title}. Farak mehsoos ho raha hai.

lines.en: Badge unlocked: {badge}.
lines.hi: Badge unlock: {badge}.

lines.en: A hidden badge. Not everyone finds this one.
lines.hi: Hidden badge. Ye har kisi ko nahi milta.

lines.en: New personal record: {record}.
lines.hi: Naya personal record: {record}.

lines.en: Your Rank GPS is ready. Let's see the route.
lines.hi: Rank GPS ready hai. Route dekhte hain.

lines.en: Readiness up {delta}. Here's why.
lines.hi: Readiness {delta} badhi. Kyun, ye dekho.

lines.en: Down {delta} this week. Here's the fix.
lines.hi: Is hafte {delta} kam. Fix ye raha.

lines.en: Route update: {move}.
lines.hi: Route update: {move}.

lines.en: {n} more study days and your GPS unlocks.
lines.hi: {n} aur study din, phir GPS unlock.

lines.en: No mistakes saved in 3 days. Your tests had wrong answers, right? That's where marks hide.
lines.hi: 3 din se koi mistake save nahi. Test mein galat toh hue honge? Marks wahin chhupe hain.

lines.en: Lots of lectures this week, few questions. Let's solve 20 PYQs today.
lines.hi: Is hafte lectures zyada, questions kam. Aaj 20 PYQ solve karte hain.

lines.en: Your revision slot slipped twice. Want me to move it earlier?
lines.hi: Revision slot do baar chhoot gaya. Thoda pehle shift karun?

lines.en: {chapter} accuracy is {acc}%. A focused drill will move it fast.
lines.hi: {chapter} ki accuracy {acc}% hai. Ek focused drill se jaldi badhegi.

lines.en: Your plans have been too heavy. I'll size them down a little.
lines.hi: Plans thode bhaari ho rahe the. Thoda halka kar deta hoon.

lines.en: Studying past midnight again. Your memory needs sleep to keep today's work.
lines.hi: Phir raat 12 ke baad padh rahe ho. Aaj ka kaam yaad rakhne ke liye neend zaroori hai.

lines.en: {hours} hours today. That's a lot. Rest is training too.
lines.hi: Aaj {hours} ghante. Bahut hai. Aaraam bhi training hai.

lines.en: What did class cover today? It keeps your revision on track.
lines.hi: Aaj class mein kya padhaya? Isse revision track pe rehta hai.

lines.en: Rough day? We'll keep it light. Just one small thing today.
lines.hi: Mushkil din? Halka rakhte hain. Aaj bas ek chhota kaam.

lines.en: Some days are heavy. You don't have to win today, just show up a little.
lines.hi: Kuch din bhaari hote hain. Aaj jeetna zaroori nahi, thoda sa aana kaafi hai.

lines.en: Want a Light Day? I'll keep only what matters.
lines.hi: Light Day karein? Sirf zaroori cheezein rakhunga.

lines.en: You've pushed hard for days. A lighter day now protects the next month.
lines.hi: Kai din se bahut push kiya hai. Aaj halka din agle mahine ko bachaata hai.

lines.en: Rest day. No guilt. Rest is part of the plan.
lines.hi: Aaraam ka din. Koi guilt nahi. Aaraam bhi plan ka hissa hai.

lines.en: You've been feeling low for a while. Talking to someone you trust really helps: a friend, family or a counsellor. If it feels heavy, Tele-MANAS (14416) is free and available any time.
lines.hi: Kuch din se mann theek nahi lag raha. Kisi bharose waale se baat karo: dost, ghar waale ya counsellor. Agar bahut bhaari lage, Tele-MANAS (14416) free hai aur kabhi bhi call kar sakte ho.

lines.en: Your climb is yours. Compare with last week's you, not anyone else.
lines.hi: Tumhara climb tumhara hai. Pichle hafte waale khud se compare karo, kisi aur se nahi.

lines.en: {friend} is studying now. Join them?
lines.hi: {friend} abhi padh raha hai. Saath join karoge?

lines.en: {friend} sent you a flame for today.
lines.hi: {friend} ne aaj ke liye flame bheja.

lines.en: Climbing is easier with a friend. Invite one and share a streak.
lines.hi: Dost ke saath climb aasaan hai. Ek ko invite karo, streak share karo.

lines.en: You and {friend} now share a flame. It grows when you both study.
lines.hi: Tum aur {friend} ab ek flame share karte ho. Dono padhoge tabhi badhega.

lines.en: {friend} already studied today. Your turn to keep the flame alive.
lines.hi: {friend} aaj padh chuka hai. Ab tumhari baari, flame zinda rakho.

lines.en: You both studied. Shared flame: {days} days.
lines.hi: Dono ne padha. Shared flame: {days} din.

lines.en: {friend} is counting on you today.
lines.hi: {friend} aaj tum pe bharosa kar raha hai.

lines.en: Your shared flame was protected today. Back at it tomorrow.
lines.hi: Aaj shared flame bach gaya. Kal se phir shuru.

lines.en: Duel on. 7 days of XP, you vs {friend}.
lines.hi: Duel shuru. 7 din XP, tum vs {friend}.

lines.en: You're {xp} XP ahead of {friend}.
lines.hi: {friend} se {xp} XP aage ho.

lines.en: {friend} leads by {xp} XP. One good session closes it.
lines.hi: {friend} {xp} XP aage hai. Ek achha session gap bhar dega.

lines.en: Duel won. Be nice about it.
lines.hi: Duel jeet gaye. Thoda humble rehna.

lines.en: {friend} took this one. Rematch next week?
lines.hi: Is baar {friend} jeeta. Agle hafte rematch?

lines.en: You're #{rank} in your {coaching} batch on Prepex this month.
lines.hi: Is mahine Prepex pe apne {coaching} batch mein #{rank} ho.

lines.en: {friend} joined from your link. You both got a new look for me.
lines.hi: {friend} tumhare link se join hua. Dono ko mere liye naya look mila.

lines.en: I'm climbing to JEE on Prepex. Join my climb: {link}
lines.hi: Main Prepex pe JEE ki taraf climb kar raha hoon. Mere climb mein join karo: {link}

lines.en: That's worth sharing. Want a card?
lines.hi: Ye share karne layak hai. Card banaun?

lines.en: 100 days to JEE. Every day from here is a page in the story.
lines.hi: JEE mein 100 din. Ab har din kahani ka ek panna hai.

lines.en: 50 days. Revision and mocks run the show now.
lines.hi: 50 din. Ab revision aur mocks hi sab kuch hain.

lines.en: 30 days. Stay steady. No new panic, just the plan.
lines.hi: 30 din. Steady raho. Naya panic nahi, bas plan.

lines.en: 10 days. Formulas, mistakes, sleep. That's it.
lines.hi: 10 din. Formulas, mistakes, neend. Bas.

lines.en: Tomorrow's the day. You've done the work. Sleep early.
lines.hi: Kal ka din hai. Kaam ho chuka hai. Jaldi so jana.

lines.en: Pexo: Your plan's ready. First up: {task}.
lines.hi: Pexo: Plan ready hai. Pehla: {task}.

lines.en: Pexo: {n} tasks today. Let's start with a short one.
lines.hi: Pexo: Aaj {n} tasks. Chhote se shuru karte hain.

lines.en: Pexo: New day, new step.
lines.hi: Pexo: Naya din, naya step.

lines.en: Pexo: {chapter} is fading. 30 minutes keeps it.
lines.hi: Pexo: {chapter} bhoolne lage ho. 30 minute mein wapas.

lines.en: Pexo: Revision slot in 15 minutes. {chapter} is waiting.
lines.hi: Pexo: 15 minute mein revision slot. {chapter} wait kar raha hai.

lines.en: Pexo: {days}-day streak. Two minutes in Prepex keeps it alive.
lines.hi: Pexo: {days} din ki streak. Prepex mein 2 minute aur streak zinda.

lines.en: Pexo: Haven't seen you today. One small session?
lines.hi: Pexo: Aaj dikhe nahi. Ek chhota session?

lines.en: Pexo: I saved your spot on the climb. Come take today's step.
lines.hi: Pexo: Climb pe tumhari jagah rakhi hai. Aaj ka step le lo.

lines.en: Pexo: One rock left in {chapter}. Finish it today?
lines.hi: Pexo: {chapter} mein ek rock bacha hai. Aaj khatam karein?

lines.en: Pexo: No catching up needed. Just today. I kept it light.
lines.hi: Pexo: Purana pending nahi. Bas aaj. Halka rakha hai.

lines.en: Pexo: Your plan's waiting, and it's a small one.
lines.hi: Pexo: Plan wait kar raha hai, chhota sa hai.

lines.en: Pexo: It's been a week. The climb's still here when you are.
lines.hi: Pexo: Ek hafta ho gaya. Jab tum aao, climb yahin hai.

lines.en: Pexo: Your week in review is ready. So is your Rank GPS.
lines.hi: Pexo: Hafte ka review ready hai. Rank GPS bhi.

lines.en: Pexo: Close your day? 45 seconds.
lines.hi: Pexo: Din close karein? 45 second.

lines.en: Pexo: Wrap today up before bed.
lines.hi: Pexo: Sone se pehle aaj ko wrap kar lo.

lines.en: Pexo: {friend} just started studying. Join in?
lines.hi: Pexo: {friend} ne abhi padhna shuru kiya. Join karoge?

lines.en: Pexo: {friend} studied today. Keep your shared flame alive.
lines.hi: Pexo: {friend} ne aaj padh liya. Shared flame zinda rakho.

lines.en: Pexo: Wednesday check on your promise. Tap to see.
lines.hi: Pexo: Promise ka Budhwar check. Tap karke dekho.

lines.en: Hi.
lines.hi: Hi.

lines.en: That tickles.
lines.hi: Gudgudi hoti hai.

lines.en: I'm here.
lines.hi: Main yahin hoon.

lines.en: Okay okay, I'm awake. Back to work.
lines.hi: Haan haan, jaag raha hoon. Chalo kaam pe.

lines.en: Still here? Me too.
lines.hi: Abhi bhi yahin? Main bhi.
